final: WITH per_race AS (SELECT r.raceId, r.name, AVG(cr.points) AS average_points, COUNT(*) AS result_count FROM constructorResults AS cr JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId WHERE cr.points >= 1.0 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name), race_name_averages AS (SELECT name, AVG(average_points) AS name_average FROM per_race GROUP BY name) SELECT p.raceId, p.name, p.average_points, p.result_count, p.average_points / n.name_average AS ratio FROM per_race AS p JOIN race_name_averages AS n ON n.name = p.name ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
